units.title: Produce the Italian Fibonacci Luna candidate
units.purpose: Implement the frozen Italian Fibonacci specification using the current Luna worker in an isolated transaction.
units.preconditions: The SPEC digest is exact; the Sol candidate is unavailable to this worker; the accepted STARCHART release is unchanged.
units.principal_postcondition: A self-contained Luna candidate and reproducible verification outputs satisfy the frozen Italian Fibonacci SPEC without reading the Sol candidate.
units.description: Implement only the Italian Fibonacci product under a Luna worker. Use a transaction-specific output area, preserve exact inputs and accounting returned by STARCHART, and do not inspect or modify the Sol candidate. Do not rebuild or modify STARCHART.
units.acceptance: The program, tests, verifier output, artifact inventory, and limitations are returned durably; all deterministic SPEC checks pass or one concrete blocker is reported; transaction accounting is preserved without invented cost figures.

units.title: Compare and package the Italian Fibonacci trials
units.purpose: Independently verify both candidates, select or reconcile the accepted product, and assemble the public product-plus-receipts directory.
units.preconditions: Both isolated candidate transactions have returned terminal evidence and neither candidate has been made canonical merely because of model identity, speed, or estimated price.
units.principal_postcondition: A reviewer can reproduce the Fibonacci checks and trace every claim from the public bundle to frozen inputs, raw Beads, raw transactions, accounting, artifacts, and digests.
units.description: Run identical deterministic checks against both candidates. Compare correctness, geometry, explanations, latency, invocations, REWORK, and recorded token/cache fields. Preserve missing accounting as missing. Select or reconcile a canonical product through Quality and manager acceptance, then create the bounded public bundle required by the SPEC. Do not change or rebuild STARCHART.
units.acceptance: Quality records a criterion-by-criterion verdict; every Fibonacci relationship is classified; the bundle contains prompt, frozen SPEC, raw Bead prints, raw relevant transaction data, process notes, canonical product, verifier, machine-readable manifest, and SHA-256 inventory; any monetary calculation cites a dated price table and remains separate from raw accounting.
